text:
customer-jane: Hi team — onboarding our prod tenant with BYOK (Azure Key Vault). When we run encrypt via the azure-sdk we get 403 AccessDenied to keys/*/encrypt even though we assigned 'Key Vault Crypto Service Encryption User' role to the VM identity. Also asking about key rotation: we plan to rotate CMK monthly and want to rewrap existing DEKs — any recommended approach? Here's the error header: `Service error (403): AccessDenied to keys/kv-prod-01/encrypt`
support-eng: Quick checklist to start: 1) Confirm vault is RBAC-enabled vs Access Policies (they're mutually exclusive). 2) Role assignment scope must be the Key Vault resource and include crypto actions. 3) For envelope encryption ensure principal has `wrapKey` and `unwrapKey` rights. 4) Confirm the vault URL (https://kv-prod-01.vault.azure.net) in your client config. Also enable KeyVault diagnostic logs to trace requests.
maria: Note — if the vault uses RBAC, built-in Access Policies are ignored. If you granted an access policy instead of RBAC role (or vice versa) that could explain 403.
olivia: For rotation strategy: recommended patterns are (a) lazy rewrap on decrypt (rewrap on first access) or (b) background backfill with rate-limited rewrap. For high QPS go lazy+background to avoid a big spike. We also recommend keeping a mapping of DEK metadata to KEK version so rewrap is deterministic.
sanjay: For AWS KMS folks: use GenerateDataKey/GenerateDataKeyWithoutPlaintext for DEK generation, and use GenerateDataKeyWithoutPlaintext to avoid ever exposing the plaintext DEK in logs. Azure similar flow: use wrapKey/unwrapKey or use Managed HSM.
support-eng: Could you paste outputs of `az keyvault show --name kv-prod-01` and `az role assignment list --assignee <client-id>`? Also include the request-id from the failed call and timestamp so we can find the diagnostic entry.
customer-jane: Pasted relevant bits: `{"properties":{"enableRbacAuthorization":true}}` and role assignment shows `Key Vault Crypto Service Encryption User` on the resource. Request-id: `2b7f9d3c-8a4e-4f12-bc9a-1234567890ab`. Timestamp: `2025-11-03T16:04:22Z`. The rotation docs are pretty thin on rewrapping DEKs created by older clients — they just say "re-encrypt with new key" but not how to validate or scale it.
security-bot: Diagnostic snippet matched: `AccessDenied` event for principal `0a1b2c3d-...` action `Microsoft.KeyVault/vaults/keys/encrypt/action` on `kv-prod-01`. Event details: missing `wrapKey`/`unwrapKey` actions in assigned RBAC role.
support-eng: Looks like the built-in role may not include both wrap/unwrap for your scenario. Quick fix: create a custom role with these explicit actions: "Microsoft.KeyVault/vaults/keys/wrap/action", "Microsoft.KeyVault/vaults/keys/unwrap/action", and assign to the service principal. Example custom role JSON can be shared.
maria: We'll add a validation step to onboarding: automated test that calls wrapKey/unwrapKey + a small encrypt/decrypt via the SDK and fail-fast if permissions are incomplete. I'll open a docs PR to include the test commands.
customer-jane: That would help a lot. Also, if we rotate weekly, will rewrap backfill kill our Dedicated throughput? We're on a reserved pool with burst but sustained qps is ~2k TPS on generation.
olivia: For 2k TPS the pattern is: 1) prefer lazy rewrap on decrypt, 2) implement a background rewrap worker that reads keys in batches and sleeps between batches (rate limit), 3) use short-lived caching of unwrapped DEKs (e.g., memcache with TTL 30s) to reduce KMS calls, 4) avoid rewrapping tokens that are still within their validity window. This keeps KMS ops steady.
support-eng: Action items for us: (A) share sample custom role JSON for Azure RBAC, (B) share a rate-limited rewrap script that uses wrapKey/unwrapKey in parallel workers, (C) PR to docs clarifying RBAC vs Access Policies and an onboarding validation checklist.
customer-jane: I'll DM tenant-id + subscription and we can run a quick validation with the request-id. Also please include a CLI snippet for `az role definition create --role-definition role.json`. Thanks! :thumbsup:
support-eng: Got it — DM received. We'll run checks against diagnostics and follow up here with the role JSON and a lightweight rewrap script. Expect first pass in ~4 hours.
customer-jane: Thanks team, appreciate the quick help.
